scope: Exploratory TRAIN-only mechanism screens; no reserved designs, temporal retraining, production changes, or combined new mechanisms.
reference: Archived seed42 frozen107/174 blend and products warning head; screen seed affects new initialization/optimizer or extractor refits, not archived references.
conditions: All37 existing measured acquisition conditions; unchanged four training views; paired fresh and replication noise families separately.

primary: near-unstable-last1% warning misses at nominal5% with actual held stable false warnings
severe optimism e>.03, stable and unstable last1% separately

decision: Descriptive promise screens, not qualification. An observed warning improvement must not increase actual held false warnings; a point-tail improvement must not increase unstable optimism, clean MAE, or far-stable pessimism. Mixed outcomes retain a tradeoff, not a success label. No outer-based retuning. Both declared screens run regardless of first-screen outcome to expose fold sensitivity.

W1.inputs: Same28 control+generic-product inputs as rank_products; richer174 inputs explicitly deferred unless the capacity-only stage survives
W1.score: Frozen -margin/.01 plus learned correction; unconstrained uncalibrated score
W1.objective: Design-balanced near-unsafe(-.01<y<0) softplus(threshold-score); per-view design-balanced sigmoid stable-flag constraints; fixed score temperature1; L2 coefficient.01; primal-dual Adam
W1.inner: First archived OOF third defines inner holdout; objective fit uses only other designs. Every margin member producing a row excludes that row's design. OOF member fits overlap across readout halves; no fully independent constrained-learning guarantee.
W1.selection: Training-only empirical policy thresholds; inner maximum per-view actual FPR violation, then near-boundary miss, then BCE for constrained heads. Ordinary classification uses held-design BCE. Record whether any inner checkpoint satisfies all declared indicator budgets. Refit whole proper set for the selected epoch count; final calibration on untouched calibration designs.
W1.frozen: All point/interval fields remain bit-identical; existing products score retained as control

S1.inputs: Unchanged174;107 frozen. Warm-start174 from proper-fit archived models, optimizing actual50/50 blend.
S1.groups: Four acquisition views crossed with stable/unstable last1%,1-5% boundary bins; design-normalized mass within each group
S1.objective: Design-balanced squared blended error/.01 plus fixed.25 tail penalty; CVaR90 of positive normalized error; weight L2.01 and proximal-to-warm-start.1
S1.inner: Archived OOF part0 member pair is warm start for training on its recorded fit rows; held query designs excluded from BOTH members. All arms share warm start, scaling, optimizer and candidate epochs.
S1.selection: Lexicographic inner stable-last1% over.03, stable-last5% over.03, guardrail violations versus inner frozen blend, stable signed p99, overall MAE. Never access outer held labels for selection. Full proper refit uses selected epochs.
S1.calibration: Recalibrate point intervals and existing warning proxy separately for each arm using original calibration designs.

N1.covariance: Independent4096-sample synthetic quiet calibration from validated existing iid/rho.8 simulator noise model; shrink5% toward diagonal; deterministic seed1147 and source index. This is NOT measured hardware calibration. Absolute noise variance cancels channel whitening, no solver/modal truth used.
N1.channel_calibration: Apply original measured51-sample per-channel scales to raw-noise covariance. Original calibrated waveform sets pre-cap prefix before whitening; estimate poles on whitened prefix; refit coefficients/offsets and energies on original calibrated channels.
N1.fits: Separate own-feature107/174 spatial MLP refits, unchanged alpha1, architecture32/16, four original training views, maxiter20000/maxfun400000; fixed archived-predictor replay also recorded.
N1.failure: Invalid inputs raise; unidentifiable modes remain explicitly unavailable. Failed training recorded, not silently treated as fitted. No removal of common sensor mean across channels.

limitations: Repeated TRAIN exploration; two screens are neither five-fold confirmation nor independent validation. Noise copies are exposures, not events. Empirical calibration budgets do not imply population risk control. No operational claim until O1 exists.
